answer_1.quote: Specifically, we used the following datasets: (i) the BioInstruct dataset for biomedical question answering, (ii) the DialogSum dataset for dialogue summarization, (iii) GSM8K for mathematical reasoning
answer_1.outputs: Generated summaries for DialogSum, answers for BioInstruct biomedical questions, and step-by-step solutions for GSM8K math problems

answer_2.quote: Performance on the BioInstruct and Dialog-Sum datasets was assessed using the ROUGE-L metric ... For the GSM8K dataset, we computed performance based on the Exact Match (EM) metric
